== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 2 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Tyler Vastag (2 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 1]] and [[Virtual Block 2]], sets dated 2009 on this wiki. The events named in the concept credits date from 2006. The concept credits also name the event or award the concept came from: Twin Cities V-Lite 2006 (1 card); Bespin Regionals 2006 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Tyler Vastag|Card Credits]].
